# axomexam

> axomexam (https://axomexam.in) is a free bilingual (Assamese & English) exam preparation platform for Assam competitive exams. It offers practice questions with answers and explanations, timed mock tests, previous year solved papers, PDF study notes and e-books — with no registration required.

## About

- Operator: axomexam.in
- Language: English and Assamese (bilingual, every question has both)
- Cost: Completely free, no account needed
- Coverage: ADRE (Assam Direct Recruitment Examination, including ADRE 2.0 and the upcoming ADRE 3.0), APSC, Assam Police / SLPRB, DHS, DME/DTE, SSC (CGL, CHSL, GD), Railway (RRB NTPC, Group D) and other Assam government recruitment exams

## Subjects

- General Knowledge (Assam History, Assam Geography, Assam Literature, Indian History, Indian Polity, Indian Economy, Art & Culture)
- Mathematics (Arithmetic, Advanced Math, Statistics & Data Interpretation)
- General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
- Reasoning Ability (Verbal, Non-Verbal, Analytical & Critical Reasoning)
- General English (Grammar, Vocabulary, Parts of Speech, Sentence Structure)
- Computer Awareness

## Content format

- Topic pages contain question-and-answer sets with explanations, in both English and Assamese.
- Mock tests are timed and follow the real exam pattern, with instant results.
- Previous year papers are provided as downloadable PDFs.
